read_changes: Root rule15 now forbids persistence of reproducible certificates, data and Actions outputs in either the repository or Releases; retain only committed scripts, parameters, run identifiers and output SHA256.
Conclusions citing a computation must name the actual script, parameters, run identifier and observed result.
The temporary earlier rule15 Release upload plan has been cancelled before any shared Release helper or workflow was published and before any Release upload.
No artificial file splitting or encoding bypass; the topic directory on current main remains limited to200000000 bytes.
Reproducible data in over-budget topics must be removed by normal commits without rewriting history or force-pushing.
An original removed file that is actually needed may be restored with git show of an explicitly recorded immutable pre-deletion public commit and path into temporary scientific work only.
The coordinator already removed about9.6GB of another topic's reproducible data; this task changes only its authorized visible-flex-exact-nearby topic.
Root rule8 still permits only sub100KB UTF8 text through the connector while no terminal executor exists; no credential or binary transfer.
The topic README, actual mathematical object, old successful scientific identities and completion standards are unchanged; no freeze or extra approval gate is introduced.

large_data_policy.existing_data_restore: git show <immutable_predeletion_commit>:<path> into temporary scientific work
